name: io.tesca.menui
description: A modern UI library for VRChat worlds, written in MenSharp: CSS-like styling, flexbox layout, fine-grained reactivity, style sheets, scrolling, virtual lists, drag and drop, text boxes, built-in components and animation (transitions, springs, Bézier curves), drawn by the GPU into a single texture.

samples.description: A CSS tour (layout, borders, shadows, z-index, style sheets, buttons), scrolling with a 10,000-row virtual list, a drag-and-drop kanban board, a form with text boxes, the built-in components with a theme switch, live resizing, and animation.
